verses.verse:
रिध मानां च छिद्राणि द्विस्वराणि भवन्ति हि।
षड्ज पंचमयोर्मानाम् चतुर्यांश मुदाह्रतम्।३५।
verses.text: The holes of Re, Dha and Ma are holes for two notes; the measure for Ṣaḍja and Pañcama is declared to be one-fourth.

commentary.text: That is, the holes made for Re, Dha and Ma should be made large, taking each as the place of two notes. Sa and Pa are acala (fixed notes), so small holes will suit them. Here by the hole of Pa is meant the last hole. Although the first hole too is the place of P̣a, this hole may also be natural. If an unnatural hole is to be made, it will have to be kept somewhat larger than the other holes.
